Cadw.subject: Indian Wildlife & National Parks
Cadw.question: The _____ was Welsh Government historic environment service.
Cadw.fact: Cadw ([ˈkadu], a Welsh verbal noun meaning "keeping/preserving") is the historic environment service of the Welsh Government and part of the Tourism and Culture group. Cadw works to protect the historic buildings and structures, the landscapes and heritage sites of Wales, to make them available for the public to visit, enjoy, and understand their significance.
